lines.text: Domino's biggest business isn't pizza. It's selling dough: 60.5% of 2025 revenue.
lines.say: Domino's biggest business isn't pizza. It's selling dough.

lines.text: In 2025, its supply chain brought in $2.99 billion of $4.94 billion in total revenue.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five, its supply chain brought in about three billion dollars, of four point nine four billion in total revenue.

lines.text: Franchisees buy dough, food and supplies from Domino's own supply chain centers.
lines.say: Franchisees buy dough, food and supplies from Domino's own supply chain centers.

lines.text: Those sales grew from $2.75 billion in 2022 to $2.99 billion in 2025.
lines.say: Those sales grew from two point seven five billion in twenty twenty-two to two point nine nine billion in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: By contrast, US franchise royalties and fees brought in $677.1 million.
lines.say: By contrast, US franchise royalties and fees brought in about six hundred seventy-seven million.

lines.text: But selling food is thin: supply chain gross margin was 11.3% in the third quarter of 2025.
lines.say: But selling food is thin. Supply chain gross margin was eleven point three percent in the third quarter of twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: The twist: stores that buy all their food from Domino's generally get 50% of the centers' pre-tax profit back.
lines.say: The twist: stores that buy all their food from Domino's generally get half of the centers' pre-tax profit back.

lines.text: Hypothetical store with $1 million in sales: a 5.5% royalty is $55,000, and 6% for national ads is $60,000.
lines.say: Picture a store with a million dollars in sales. A five and a half percent royalty is fifty-five thousand, and six percent for national ads is sixty thousand.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Domino's biggest business isn't pizza. It's selling dough
post.ig:
Domino's biggest business isn't pizza. It's selling dough to its stores.

Fiscal 2025: supply chain revenue $2.99B, 60.5% of $4.94B total; U.S. franchise royalties and fees $677.1M.
Supply chain gross margin was 11.3% in Q3 2025, and stores that buy all their food from Domino's generally get 50% of the centers' pre-tax profit.
U.S. franchisees generally pay a 5.5% royalty and 6% to national ads: $55,000 and $60,000 on a hypothetical $1M store.

Sources: Domino's Pizza, Inc. fiscal 2025 10-K and quarterly results.
